draft.emotion: tender and sympathetic, feeling someone else's discomfort
notes: Used like 'gustar': the body part or thing causing pain is the subject, and the person feeling it is the indirect object (Me duele la cabeza, Me duelen los pies).
Stem-changing verb (o → ue) in the present tense, used almost exclusively in the third person: duele (singular) and duelen (plural).
